rationale: utils/uuid.ts uuidv7(timestampMs?). Go UUIDv7(*int64) (string, error): the optional argument is a pointer and the thrown RangeError for a timestamp outside 0..2**48-1 is the returned error (language mechanics). Test-mapping packages/ai/test/uuid.test.ts records all four upstream cases ported plus the sequence-exhaustion case; the 1.5/NaN/Infinity rows cannot occur for an int64.

utils/error-body.ts normalizeProviderError(unknown). Go takes any and returns NormalizedProviderError; the typed raw-error carrier stands in for the SDK property bag. Test-mapping packages/ai/test/error-body.test.ts records all sixteen upstream cases ported with exact status/body/message values and the 4000-character cap.

utils/node-http-proxy.ts resolveHttpProxyUrlForTarget(targetUrl, env?). Go takes the target as a string and returns (*url.URL, error); the URL|undefined result is a nil pointer and a parse failure is the error. Test-mapping packages/ai/test/node-http-proxy.test.ts records all five upstream cases ported, and Bedrock's HTTP request uses the resolver.
utils/model-operations.ts getModelType(model: AnyModel). Go GetModelType(AnyModel) returns the model's ModelType; the keyof ModelTypeMap result is the closed ModelType string set.

fuzzy.ts fuzzyFilter<T>(items, query, getText). Go FuzzyFilter[T] has the same generic shape. Test-mapping packages/tui/test/fuzzy.test.ts records all 14 upstream cases ported with per-case citations and a compiling mutation.

utils.ts visibleWidth(str) is tui/widthx.VisibleWidth(string) int, in the width package that both the renderer and truncation use. Test-mapping packages/tui/test/truncate-to-width.test.ts records all 16 upstream cases ported, including the Indic, CJK, Myanmar and Thai/Lao samples.
terminal-image.ts deleteAllKittyImages() returns the Kitty delete-all escape; Go returns the same byte string (asserted at terminal_image_upstream_test.go:174).
terminal-image.ts hyperlink(text, url) wraps text in OSC 8; Go Hyperlink(text, url string) string is the same function. Ported upstream case in terminal-image.test.ts.

terminal-image.ts imageFallback(mimeType, dimensions?, filename?). Go takes *ImageDimensions for the optional argument and the empty string for an absent filename. Ported upstream cases in terminal-image.test.ts.

terminal-image.ts renderImage(base64Data, dimensions, options?) returns {sequence, columns, rows, imageId?} | null; Go returns a *renderedImage with the same fields (ImageID 0 for an absent imageId) and nil for null. Ported upstream encoding and cell-sizing cases (test-mapping packages/tui/test/terminal-image.test.ts).
keys.ts decodeKittyPrintable(data) returns string | undefined; Go returns (string, bool). Test-mapping packages/tui/test/keys.test.ts records the keys.test.ts set ported.
terminal-image.ts getCapabilities(); Go returns the TerminalCapabilities value computed from the same detection and overrides.
terminal-image.ts setCapabilities(caps) overrides the cached capabilities; Go SetCapabilities(TerminalCapabilities) does the same under the capability mutex.
terminal-image.ts setCellDimensions(dims); Go SetCellDimensions(CellDimensions). Used by the ported cell-size cases.
